name: FZ Consent Banner and Logs
author: Niko

sections.description:
This plugin provides cookie consent banner and audit logging for personal data compliance:
– Cookie consent banner with accept/reject buttons and granular cookie settings
– Consent checkboxes for comments, WooCommerce, WPForms and Contact Form 7
– Consent logging with CSV export
– Admin dashboard with paginated logs
– Support for analytics counters (Yandex.Metrika, Google Analytics) with consent-based loading

External Services

This plugin optionally loads analytics counters based on user consent. These are third-party services:

Google Analytics (gtag.js)

The plugin can load Google Analytics tracking script from googletagmanager.com when the user provides consent for analytics cookies. This is used to track website visits and user interactions.
– Service provider: Google LLC
– Data sent: Page views, user interactions, anonymized IP address (depending on configuration)
– Terms of Service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Analytics (analytics.js)

For legacy Universal Analytics tracking IDs (UA-XXXXXXXX-X), the plugin loads analytics.js from google-analytics.com.
– Service provider: Google LLC
– Data sent: Page views, user interactions
– Terms of Service: https://marketingplatform.google.com/about/analytics/terms/us/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Yandex.Metrika

The plugin can load Yandex.Metrika counter script from mc.yandex.ru when the user provides consent for analytics cookies. This is used to track website visits and user behavior.
– Service provider: Yandex LLC
– Data sent: Page views, clicks, user behavior data
– Terms of Service: https://yandex.com/legal/metrica_termsofuse/
– Privacy Policy: https://yandex.com/legal/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “Settings -> FZ Consent Banner and Logs” to configure
sections.changelog:

  • Added WPForms and Contact Form 7 support
  • Built-in wpDiscuz compatibility
  • Added cookie categories (Necessary, Analytics, Marketing)
  • Added analytics counters support (Yandex.Metrika, Google Analytics)

1.0.0

  • Initial release
